scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R public/. dist && cp public/brief.html dist/brief.html && mkdir -p dist/brief && cp public/brief.html dist/brief/index.html
scripts.typecheck: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['public/index.html','public/brief.html'].forEach(f=>{const h=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'); if(!/<h1[\s>]/.test(h)) throw new Error('missing h1 '+f); if(!/Chapter 1 of 3/.test(fs.readFileSync('public/index.html','utf8'))) throw new Error('chapter label'); console.log(f+' ok')})"
